raw_segments.text: Leance, the blessed gods purge all infection from our air whilst you do climate here.
You have a holy father, a graceful gentleman, against whose person, so sacred as it is.
I have done sin, for which the heavens, taking angry note, have left me ishulous.
And your father's blessed, as he from heaven merits it, with you, worthy his goodness.
